name: Choline
description: Nutrient used to make cell membranes and acetylcholine; the “C” in MIC blends, as choline chloride

status.studiedFor: No studies found for energy or fat loss
status.humanEvidence: No human studies found for this use
status.usStatus: Not FDA approved for energy or weight loss

note.text: No published human study of injected choline, alone or in MIC blends, for energy or fat loss was found.

bullets: Used to make **cell membranes** and the nerve messenger **acetylcholine**
The **“C” in MIC** (methionine, inositol, choline) injections
**In people,** a mechanism for energy or fat loss is not established
No human study of choline injections found
No study of MIC blends for energy or fat loss
Lab and animal work not reviewed for this use

practical.soldAs: Compounded (Rx) MIC and lipotropic blends; not FDA approved

regulatory.text: Only approved form: Choline C 11, a PET scan agent
Not listed; IV over 100 mL per 12 h banned (M2.2)

references: FDA (DailyMed), Choline C 11 Injection label, Dec 2025
FDA, Bulk drug substances nominated under section 503A (categories), May 2026
